title: Output Configuration
description: The configuration of the inputs for a Health Technology Assessment simulation

patients.description: The number of patients to be simulated

timeHorizon.description: The time horizon of the simulation (expressed in years)

studyYear.description: The year in which the study is conducted (useful for updating costs)

baseCase.description: Whether to perform a base case simulation by using the expected values for every second order parameter

PSARuns.description: The number of runs to be performed within the Probabilistic Sensitivity Analysis

defaultDiscountRateForCosts.description: The discount rates to be applied by default to costs

defaultDiscountRateForEffects.description: The discount rates to be applied by default to health outcomes

disutilityCombinationMethod.description: The method to be used to combine different disutilities
